name: core
title: Mesh core
summary: Shared Mesh compose and runtime directives stamped under core/v0.1 (@transport, @merge, @source, @resolveTo, @hoist, @extraSchemaDefinitionDirective).
notes: Mesh stitching @source uses subgraph: (and optional type:). Apollo Connectors @source uses http: and lives under specs.apollo.dev/connect.
Older Mesh stamps may still import @pubsubOperation / @pubsubPublish from core/v0.1. Prefer the pubsub family for new schemas.

name: pubsub
title: Mesh pubsub
summary: PubSub subscription and publish field directives for webhook / topic bindings.
notes: Family URL for new Mesh @link stamps. Readers may still accept the same directive names imported from core/v0.1 on older SDL.

name: auth
title: Mesh auth
summary: Mesh-owned auth helpers used with Hive Gateway generic auth (alongside Federation @authenticated / @requiresScopes).

name: rate-limit
title: Mesh rate-limit
summary: Field-level rate limit hints consumed by Hive Gateway rateLimiting.
notes: Enable rateLimiting in the gateway config so directive annotations are enforced.

name: sql
title: Mesh SQL
summary: SQL table mapping directive emitted by the Mesh SQL loader and executed by transport-sql.
notes: Pair with @transport from core/v0.1 for subgraph location and kind.

name: thrift
title: Mesh Thrift
summary: Thrift binary RPC field mapping directive.
notes: Pair with @transport from core/v0.1. JSON Thrift uses Connectors @connect instead.

name: mongo
title: Mesh Mongo
summary: MongoDB operation binders emitted by the Mesh Mongo loader.

name: neo4j
title: Mesh Neo4j
summary: Neo4j GraphQL model directives with optional Mesh subgraph attribution.
notes: Mesh adds optional subgraph: for multi-source attribution; strip before handing model SDL to @neo4j/graphql.
